Text: Full name is required.
fullName is a string with maxLength 50.
Mobile number is required and must be a valid Saudi mobile number; it is the login identifier. API pattern ^05[0-9]{8}$.
Email is optional. If given the customer receives a welcome email. API: email is optional with format email.
Password must be at least 8 characters.
password is required with minLength 6.
Date of birth is required; customers must be 18 or older.
As a visitor aged 16 or older I can create an account; the account is created after the mobile number is verified.

Source: prd.pdf R6; user-stories.docx US-5; openapi.yaml POST /v1/signup
Text: The customer chooses Arabic or English (language ar/en required in API); the app supports both and all screens appear in the chosen language.
The customer must accept the Terms and Conditions before signing up.
Notes: Not in API request or mock-up

Text: A mobile number that is already registered cannot be used to sign up again (API returns 409).
A visitor without a Saudi mobile number can sign up with email instead; a verification link is sent to the email.
After the form is submitted a pending account is created and an OTP is sent by SMS.
A wrong OTP shows an error (API 400 Wrong code).
API code is exactly 4 digits (^[0-9]{4}$). Story notes and mock-up show six digit boxes.
An expired code returns 410 Code expired.

Source: prd.pdf R11; user-stories.docx US-3; openapi.yaml POST /v1/otp/resend
Text: The customer can request a new OTP (202 New code sent); a new code is sent. Too many requests returns 429.
When the number is verified the account is created/active and the customer is logged in (API returns accessToken and points).

Source: prd.pdf R13; user-stories.docx US-4; openapi.yaml POST /v1/otp/verify 200
Text: Every new member receives 50 welcome points; balance shows 50.
Customers log in with mobile number and password.
Notes: No login API or screen provided

Text: The account is locked after several failed login attempts.
Personal data is stored securely.
Registration must be fast.
The sign-up screens must be user-friendly.
Users are new customers in Saudi Arabia who are 18 or older.
Error messages will be provided by the content team later.
Sign-up screen fields: Full name; Mobile number (05XXXXXXXX); Password; Date of birth; Language buttons Arabic/English; Sign up button. No terms checkbox and no email field.
Verify screen: 'Verify your number' with six code boxes; text 'Enter the code we sent by SMS.'; Verify button; Resend code link.

Web form: full name maxlength 40; mobile pattern ^05[0-9]{8}$; password minlength 6; date of birth required; language select with العربية and English; terms checkbox required. Empty submit shows five English messages (name; mobile starting with 05; password at least 6 characters; 18 or older; accept terms).
Web form has no email field. A valid submission goes to the OTP page with no message.
Web verify page has six digit boxes (one digit each) and shows 'Resend code (30)'; heading 'Verify your mobile number' and text 'We sent a code by SMS. Enter it below.'.
Verify page shows the Arabic message 'الرمز غير صحيح' for empty, invalid and the tried 'valid' codes while the rest of the page is English.
